1.overview: Paul greets the saints in Ephesus and praises God for choosing, adopting, redeeming, and sealing believers in Christ as part of his plan to unite all things under Christ. He prays that they will know their calling, inheritance, and God’s power, shown in Christ’s resurrection, exaltation, and headship over the church.

2.overview: Paul contrasts humanity’s former death in sin with God’s action in making people alive with Christ, raising them with him, and saving them by grace through faith rather than works, for a life of good works. He describes how Christ brings Gentiles near, makes Jews and Gentiles one through the cross, and builds them together into God’s household and dwelling place.

3.overview: Paul describes his commission by God’s grace to reveal that Gentiles share in the promise of Christ, and explains that the church displays God’s wisdom to the heavenly powers. He prays that the Father will strengthen believers through the Spirit so they can know Christ’s love and be filled with God’s fullness, then gives glory to God in Christ.

sections.heading: Paul’s Commission and the Revealed Mystery
The Mystery Made Known Through the Church

4.overview: Paul urges the Ephesians to live in unity, grounded in one body, Spirit, hope, Lord, faith, baptism, and God, and describes Christ’s gifts and leaders as equipping the church to grow into maturity. He contrasts the Gentiles’ former way of life with the new self in Christ and calls for truthful, constructive, forgiving conduct shaped by the Holy Spirit.

5.overview: Paul calls the Ephesians to imitate God through love, reject impurity and corrupt speech, and live as children of light with wisdom and Spirit-filled worship. He then describes mutual submission and the distinct responsibilities of wives and husbands, grounding marital love in Christ’s relationship with the church.

sections.heading: Marriage and Christ’s relationship with the church

6.overview: Paul instructs children and parents, then slaves and masters, on their conduct within household relationships. He calls believers to stand against spiritual powers with God’s armor and persistent prayer, asks for prayer for his gospel proclamation, sends Tychicus with news, and closes with greetings and a blessing.
